logging_enabled.description: Enable logging of NTP events (e.g., synchronization changes) to syslog.

servers.description: List of NTP servers to synchronize with. At least one is recommended for basic operation.

host.description: Hostname or IP address of the NTP server.

port.description: UDP port number for NTP (standard is 123).

listen_addresses.description: List of local addresses to bind the NTP daemon for client queries. By default, only loopback is used unless server_mode is enabled.

address.description: IPv4 or IPv6 address to bind (e.g., '192.168.1.100', '::1').

server_mode.description: Enable the NTP server mode (accept and respond to client queries). Requires listen on '*' if enabled.

allowed_networks.description: List of networks or hosts explicitly permitted to query this NTP server. Applies only when server_mode is enabled.

mask.description: Prefix length (e.g., 24 for IPv4, 64 for IPv6). If omitted, assumes full host.

restricted_networks.description: List of networks or hosts explicitly denied from querying this NTP server.

leapfile.description: Path to leap seconds file (e.g., '/usr/share/zoneinfo/leap-seconds.list'). Optional; if omitted, OpenNTPD uses built-in leap seconds table.

no_initial_step.description: Skip initial time step on startup (use slew instead), preventing large clock jumps. Recommended for servers.

strict_sync.description: Enable strict synchronization: reject servers with suspicious offsets or high dispersion.
